name: Beexy Connector
author: Voxxy Creative Lab
upgrade_notice: First signed release over the beexy.io update channel.

sections.description: Same-origin reverse proxy that keeps the Beexy first-party cookie set (_bx_*) alive under Safari ITP by rewriting the Set-Cookie Domain on a first-party path.
sections.changelog:
0.2.1 — 2026-10-11

  • First off-gallery signed release: off-gallery auto-update channel (plugin-update-checker v5) backed by the public cdn-beexy-connector repo behind updates.beexy.io.
  • Ed25519 package signing, verified at upgrader_pre_download before install (fail-closed; best-effort downgrade guard).
  • Corrected the Beexy domain beexy.com to beexy.io (update channel, Plugin URI/homepage, and the License Gate default).
